items.note: G.3.1-G.3.2 give the restoring schedule, gather/scatter over triples with side wires cancelling intersection coefficients, and the three-stage map (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring scratch, but omit h=100, N, m=h^3, the neighbour rules, the coefficient values and the stage composition (x,y+x),(-y,y+x),(-y,x); the infer steps do not reproduce the proof at 741-765.
G.3.3 states the common frame per gate, that it commutes with pointwise gates, the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1} and the edge cost D_vD_u^{-1}, matching 804-817.

G.3.4 names nested nondegenerate subspaces of an m-dimensional space but gives none of the content: no triple-indicator construction, no statement that only the central 3->4 edges decrease (by h), no L=Ich, no budget Wm-2N+2L, no L/N ratios.

G.3.5 states rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the endpoint identity I_m on every role and the shear H<-H+D with s<Wm, but omits the source matrices -P_{U_a}, the N rank-one source exceptions and the formula s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.

G.3.6 has phase frames C_U, edge differences as products of kernels aI+bX_v, s_c<W_c m and C^{tensor m} by telescoping; it omits one kernel (or inverse) per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and the source/sink diagonal corrections needed before telescoping gives C^{tensor m}.

The plan repeatedly states s<Wm and that tau<1 with s/W<m^tau, but never gives the reason L<N/2, the deficits eta_b, eta_c, or the explicit tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} derived from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20.

G.1 lists the O(V) split/merge/digit-move/cyclic row-split operations; G.2 the controlled update y+a(controls) mod q^b and fixed rational unit scaling in O(V), with the two-piece split-and-swap for shifts as at 575-581.

Factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 and the shear procedure (triangular changes, one interchange per one of Pi between two controlled updates, undo) follow 1432-1446; the elimination proof of the factorization (1375-1392) and the choice of the fixed prime q avoiding denominators (1413-1423) are not shown.

Row split into W role streams, frame shears per edge, H<-H+D on every row, the three-update interchange, s calls on V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and F_k=O(e^tau) all follow the paper; the fixed-tape depth-first schedule that justifies the O(1) node term (1559-1615) is missing.

S1.2 states (p,h,g,d,z)->(p,d,g,h,z) in O(Vu^tau) and sketches the construction (rho=O(log e) high digits as rows, padding, base-m pieces, radix padding) as in 1650-1734, but as one infer step without sub-steps.

S2.1 has H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D, s_c child calls on f=e/m axes plus binary row additions; missing are the conjugation by P_M that puts residual directions into coordinate slots (1849-1862) and the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z (1885-1888).

S2.1.3 has the eight packed cyclic shifts, the restored third chunk, deterministic repair of an exceptional set and cost O(V(L^tau+1)); it omits delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}} and the full bound with M A^3 and delta_bad terms that reduce to O(V(L^tau+1)) only in the parameter family.

S2.2 states F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) and S2.3 the geometric internal sum; the leaf case F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, K<=e^{c/beta}, the row index from the first q_0 chunks, and the condition lambda'>sigma+beta(1-sigma) from the leaves are missing.

S2 states the layer in O(Vd^lambda') exact in Gaussian dyadics with one truncation and S2.4 the guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) and error below sqrt2 2^{-p}; the arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E behind Delta is not shown.

The sub-steps follow the proof: roots as signed shifts and F^+F^-=I/t, bit-reversed stored order B_t, grouped rounds as contractions, prefix moves O(TpdK), at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges O(Tp pK^{tau-1}), layer rounds O(Tpd^{lambda'}), error sqrt2 l 2^{-p}, exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}.
Evaluation at a large power of two, the established O(N log N) multiplier, centred residues and O(rp log(rp)) match 3221-3265; B_0=2^{4p} is not given.

Retained LB order (pointwise products commute with the record permutation), the normalization via F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g), the error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} and the O(Tp log(rp)) product cost follow the proof; S4.4 compresses how 3delta+eta arises.

S5.1-S5.2 give P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA and RF_s=2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A with contractions and linewise error dp^2, but omit the hypothesis theta=t/s-1>p/alpha^4, the definitions of P_s,P_t, and the costs O(tp^{3/2+delta}alpha) and O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)).

Both identities are stated correctly and S5.4 gives the paper's reason (RF^+R=F^+ and permutations commute with pointwise products); the coefficient computation proving the chirp identity (3941-3951) and the normalization step F(u*v)=S Fu.Fv are not shown.

S6.1 gives b, p=6b, d, axes of length r/2 or r, primes below t_i, T/2<S<T; it writes T~n/b instead of T in [4n/b,8n/b), omits the prime window (1-2eta)t_i<s_i<=(1-eta)t_i, alpha, gamma, and the fixed exponents other than kappa.

S6.3 states the map x->prod x_i^{mu_i} as an isomorphism preserving convolution and its triangular controlled-shift implementation, but does not define mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i or give the triangular formula or its cost.

The exact twist isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j and M_C=D_-iota^{-1}M_r(iota D_+f, iota D_+g)=f*g/T are faithful to 4303-4342; the computed version and its twist errors (4349-4413) are absent.

Source transform A, chirp transform, B_0, 2^gamma with exact counterpart RF_s, conjugate procedure, and the six-step algorithm with the two scalings by S all match; the input scaling of digits by 2^{-b-2}, which the final 2^{2b+4} undoes, is never stated.
The final bound 448b 2^{-b+gamma}<=448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and carries are correct, but the error chain E_ring, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, E_w=S(3E_s+2) and the use of gamma<=b/4 are not shown.

Normalizing by Tp, seven dominant costs, min margin 2^{-181}=2kappa and absorption of log factors are correct, but the cost expressions (dK, pK^{tau-1}, ...) and the minimizing margin g_2=epsilon c(1-tau) are not given.
No step mentions the n log n conjecture or the liminf argument; S0 states only the time bound.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route: finite networks with s<Wm, power-width and arbitrary-width interchange, simultaneous layers via phase frames, synthetic transforms and convolution, resampling and chirp, the multiplication algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table. It thins out at the source of the saving: the label budget Wm-2N+2L, the loss L=Ich with L/N<1/2, and the explicit tau=1-2^{-50} are not stated, so s<Wm is asserted rather than explained. The guard-bit and error chains are also given only as end results.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch over three-element subsets is stated, but h=100, the triple indexing with N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are absent.
Common frame per gate commuting with pointwise gates, operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, edge cost D_vD_u^{-1}.
Nested nondegenerate subspaces of an m-dimensional space are named, but not the construction in F^{tensor 3}, the comparability of edges, or that only central 3->4 edges decrease, each by h.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U is stated as the edge cost; the N rank-one source exceptions are omitted.
Neither sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich, nor s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b appears.
s<Wm is asserted, but L/N=100/539 or 101/539 and the deficit N-2L>0 that produce it are absent.
Endpoint difference I_m on every role gives the shear H<-H+D on every role; the -P_{U_a} source matrices are not given.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node are all stated.

The recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and F_k=O(e^tau) under s/W<m^tau are there, but the explicit exponent tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 is absent, so half the step is missing; the conservative verdict is chosen.

central.summary: The plan has the frame principle, rank equal to dimension change, the endpoint shear and the matrix-shear recursion, and states the recurrence. It never explains why s<Wm: the label construction, the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, the ratio L/N<1/2 and the explicit tau=1-2^{-50} are missing or only named.
